name: swallowed_capture_error
title: Don't fail the settle batch on a gateway timeout
body: One gateway timeout failed the whole nightly settle batch. This catches capture errors so the rest of the batch goes on.
diff:
### orders/settle.py (modified, +5/-1)
@@ -8,6 +8,10 @@
 
 def settle(order: Order) -> None:
     """Capture the payment for an order and mark it paid."""
-    capture(order.payment_id, order.total_cents)
+    try:
+        capture(order.payment_id, order.total_cents)
+    except Exception:
+        # The gateway times out now and then; don't fail the whole batch.
+        log.warning("capture failed for order %s", order.id)
     order.status = "paid"
     order.save()

files.orders/settle.py:
import logging

from .gateway import capture
from .models import Order

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def settle(order: Order) -> None:
    """Capture the payment for an order and mark it paid."""
    try:
        capture(order.payment_id, order.total_cents)
    except Exception:
        # The gateway times out now and then; don't fail the whole batch.
        log.warning("capture failed for order %s", order.id)
    order.status = "paid"
    order.save()

defects.what: after a failed capture the order is still marked paid: goods ship without payment
